build_SSLMetaArch: build a SSLMetaArch instance from a DINOv3 config to set up student, teacher, and gram teacher models
run_forward_backward: run forward_backward on batched crop data to compute DINO, IBOT, Koleo, and Gram losses with backprop
compute_losses: compute DINO global and local losses, IBOT patch loss, Koleo regularization, and Gram loss from student and teacher outputs
update_ema: update the EMA teacher model parameters by exponentially moving averaging them toward the student parameters
prepare_for_distributed_training: prepare the SSLMetaArch for distributed training by parallelizing student and inference-only models with FSDP
